hardware: one node, 4 H100 80GB, preferably SXM with NVLink; DDP, one full BF16 replica per GPU

smoke.purpose: Check finite loss, masking, memory, adapter save/reload; not persona quality

pilot.purpose: First proof of concept, 250 examples per country; inspect before another run

pilot-3epochs.purpose: Optional learning-curve experiment from the same base, after first-epoch review

balanced.purpose: Data-size comparator, 416 examples per country, matched one-epoch schedule

CHN.purpose: Separate-adapter comparator; same country subset as shared balanced

DEU.purpose: Separate-adapter comparator; same country subset as shared balanced

all-data-ablation.purpose: Optional deliberately skewed pool; not the default recommendation
